description: Drop the five `/v1/connector/consoles/{id}/*path` operations (ConnectorGet/Post/Put/Patch/Delete). Their route ends in a wildcard segment `*path`, which is not a path template variable, so the generated call would send the literal `*path`. They are also redundant: the Network, Protect and InnerSpace services already reach a console through this connector (`remoteConsole`), with typed operations. Source: the route and its `path` parameter in the published Site Manager 1.0.0 OpenAPI document.
